headline: Bank of England Weighs Raising High-Risk Mortgage Cap to Five Times Income
summary: The Bank of England is considering raising the lending cap on high-risk mortgages to five times a borrower's income, according to Financial Times reports.
why: Changes to mortgage lending caps by the central bank directly influence housing market liquidity, consumer borrowing limits, and banking sector risk exposure.

impacts.name: UK Banking Sector
impacts.why: Altering mortgage lending caps impacts residential lending volumes and risk profiles for banks.
